notes.title: 🎉 Perv's Hotel - Major Content Update Now Live! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to announce that Perv’s Hotel has just received a brand new update packed with fresh content and scenes! This latest release brings major new events and interactions with all the girls — but especially Evelina, Gertrud, and Alex, who have each received significant expansions to their storylines.

Whether you're continuing your journey or just getting started, now is the perfect time to dive in.

💥 To celebrate this big update, the game is now 25% OFF for a limited time!
Don’t miss your chance to experience the new content and save while you do!

Thank you all for your support, and stay tuned — more surprises are coming soon!

❤️ The Perv’s Hotel Team

notes.title: NEW RELEASE AVAILABLE!!!
notes.notes:
**🚨 Major Update Announcement for *PERV'S HOTEL: Lust from Sweden*! 🚨**

Dear guests of *PERV'S HOTEL*,  

We’re thrilled to announce that the **new major update** for *PERV'S HOTEL: Lust from Sweden* is now available! This exciting update brings fresh content, enhanced features, and even more of the spicy, tantalizing experience you’ve come to love. 🌶️  

**What’s New in the Update?**  
🛏️ **New Storylines & Choices** – Dive deeper into the seductive world of *PERV'S HOTEL* with brand-new branching storylines and steamy interactions. Your choices matter more than ever!  
🎨 **Visual Enhancements** – Updated artwork, and a more immersive atmosphere to heighten your experience.  
🔥 **Performance Upgrades** – Thanks to several fixing, due to your precious feedback!
💎 **Exclusive Scenes** – Unlock never-before-seen events that will surprise and excite even the most dedicated fans.  

**How to Get the Update?**  
The update is **FREE** for everyone who already owns the game! Simply update your game via Steam to dive into the newest version.  

If you haven’t yet joined the unforgettable world of *PERV'S HOTEL*, now’s the perfect time to check in. 😉

---

🎉 Don’t wait—download the update now and experience *PERV'S HOTEL: Lust from Sweden* like never before. Thank you for your continued support, and as always, enjoy your stay!
